verdict.rationale: Polar's docs describe automated dunning: a failed renewal moves the subscription to past_due instead of cancelling it, and Polar emails the customer a Customer Portal link to update their payment method. Retries run on a published schedule (2, 5, 7 and 7 days, up to 21 days), and the past_due_at and next_payment_attempt_at fields are exposed. The schedule is fixed rather than adaptive, so the 'smart' part of the story is not evidenced. Missing for 10: smart/adaptive retry timing (the schedule is fixed), merchant-configurable retry or email settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
